proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ T a b u v hT hu hTu hTv hv hab
  have hsym : ∀ x y, inner 𝕜 (T x) y = inner 𝕜 x (T y) := fun x y => by
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, hT]
  have ha : (starRingEnd 𝕜) a = a := by
    have h := hsym u u
    rw [hTu, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right] at h
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hu) h
  have hb : (starRingEnd 𝕜) b = b := by
    have h := hsym v v
    rw [hTv, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right] at h
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (inner_self_ne_zero.mpr hv) h
  refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
  have h := hsym u v
  rw [hTu, hTv, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, ha] at h
  have h2 : (a - b) * inner 𝕜 u v = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, h, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab)
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (T : H →L[𝕜] H) (a b : 𝕜) (u v : H), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T = T → u ≠ 0 → T u = a • u → T v = b • v → v ≠ 0 → a ≠ b → (starRingEnd 𝕜) a = a ∧ inner 𝕜 u v = 0
